title: Paul McCartney live: Silverdome, Pontiac | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Pontiac Silverdome in Pontiac, Michigan, USA, on 4 June 1993.

It was the 32nd night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993. The show was seen by 49,378 fans.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.
